name: Kurt Howell
source:
Kurt is a priest who runs a temple to the god Ragsiel. He meets Might and his allies when they come to his temple to receive help on their quest from Ragsiel, and Kurt also joins the quest against Herdeus. He is a somewhat quiet and extremely polite individual who is very devoted to his god.

[From: [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/silver/silver.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
